newsitem.title: USA: Seidman Group raises stake in Wayne.
newsitem.headline: Seidman Group raises stake in Wayne.

text.p: A group led by investor Lawrence Seidman said Wednesday it raised its stake in Wayne Bancorp to 193,800 common shares or 8.68 percent from 6.50 percent held previously.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 71,200 common shares bought between August 12 and October 10 at prices ranging from $12.50 to $14 per share.

In a meeting with representatives of Wayne, Seidman group representatives suggested two new qualified persons be placed on the board of directors without Wayne Bancorp incurring any additional cost, the filing said.
The Seidman group said it will shortly provide Wayne with the names of qualified board candidates, the filing said.
